audit.whatIsWrong: "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" is used throughout as Hwei's key CC ability, but Hwei has no ability named that. His CC lives on E, which enemyAbilities names "Subject: Torment".
audit.why: enemyKit.abilities E has hardCC/slow flags and enemyAbilities.E = "Subject: Torment"; there is no "Subject: Fear" or "CC Paints" anywhere in the kit data.
Subject: Torment (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and Soraka's Equinox is 20/19/18/17/16s — both are concrete and matchup-relevant.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now states both real cooldown curves.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Subject: Serenity (W)'s shield absorbing burst is never mentioned; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleed from tradeGood/tradeBad instead of matchup-specific content.
audit.why: Hwei's W shield changes all-in math and should be baited before a commit; both bled bullets fail COPY_PASTE_BLEED lint.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1] rewritten around forcing the W shield out early; dontsFull[2] rewritten around Subject: Torment's zone lingering near wards.

edits.before: Triage through the chip era and out-global the rest. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.
edits.after: Triage through the chip era and out-global the rest. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and owning the chip ledger and the tempo it buys.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment (E), denying your pattern, and owning the chip ledger and the tempo it buys.

edits.before: - Soraka vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.
edits.after: - Soraka vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Engage only on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment (E) — that is your full-commit window.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment (E): all his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Bait the answer, then sign.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Bait the answer, then sign.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Equinox banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Subject: Torment (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and carries all his CC — dodge the paint and the burst chain never starts. - Your Equinox (E) is 20/19/18/17/16s: bank it for his combo, not chip poke. - His R (Spiraling Despair) is 120/100/80s — a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Q the refill, W the carry, repeat — the battery economy runs while their math wonders why nothing dies.
edits.after: Force his shield (Subject: Serenity, W) out early — it absorbs your burst window, so bait it before your duo commits to an all-in.

edits.before: Healing into a full rotation with the bank empty — Soraka without Q refills is a donation with a horn.
edits.after: Warding his snare lines blind — Subject: Torment's zone lingers, so ward from outside its range or you eat the root you came to scout.
